invmarket_stallholder.text: Roll up. Tablet, tartan, tea towels, and a duck that is purely decorative.
There has been a market here since the 1870s. After a fire in 1889 it was rebuilt, with the grand arches you walked under.

invmarket_shinty.text: Shinty is played with a stick called a caman. It is like hockey, but you may hit the ball in the air. Mind your head.
The sticks are sold on the corner stall. Buy one and the whole town will expect you to turn up on Saturday.

hall_stallholder.text: Fit like? Och, no, that's Aberdeen. Welcome to Inverness. Whit can I dae for ye?
Have a look at the board. Naebody gets fleeced in the Victorian Market. Or only slightly.
Awa ye go, then. Mind the rain. Or the sun. It tends to be one or the other, and fast.
